title: Commonwealth Securities Limited (Commsec) - acquisition of Neville Ward Direct Pty Limited

body_sections.Summary: Commonwealth Securities Limited (Commsec) -  acquisition of Neville Ward Direct Pty Limited
body_sections.Competition analysis: Commsec and Neville Ward Direct both offer an internet based investment information and fund broking service.  A large numbers of competitors offer similar services, and the market share of the merged entity is likely to be small.  Consequently, the acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition.
